description:
Replace the entire ordered rule list only after user confirmation (confirmed=true).
Use the rule contract and revision from get_publication_replacements; [] removes all rules.
If revision is stale, reread the rules before saving. Rules do not affect summaries or past posts.
Private-source publication consent must already exist; this action does not grant it.
Enabling rules in a legacy native-forward destination requires a separate explicit choice:
configure_publication settings with adopt_media_preferences:true and the chosen media switches.
name: set_publication_replacements
title: Set Publication Replacements
